name: Yooca: Next Horizon
detailed_description:
Yooca: Next Horizon is a social-life RPG set in a vibrant multiplayer open world where your story is shaped by the choices you make, the skills you master, and the quests you take on.

Start as a nobody. Grow into somebody.
Build your Character Traits – Nett Worth, Authority, Influence, and Strength – through meaningful gameplay across diverse activities and social experiences. Whether you're running a café, acing a trivia showdown, performing live music, or completing crafting quests, every action you take leaves its mark on your journey.

Forge your path, shape your destiny, and rise to become a legend in the Youniverse.

🧭 Core Gameplay

  • Grow Your Character Traits:
    Your journey is defined by four key traits –
    💰 Nett Worth (earn and accumulate wealth),
    🗣️ Influence (social clout and popularity),
    🏋️ Strength (fitness and stamina),
    👑 Authority (your rank, reputation, and impact).
    Level them up through gameplay, choices, and achievements.

  • Master New Skills:
    From cooking and cycling to piano and singing, Yooca: Next Horizon lets you learn and master a wide variety of skills. Improve them over time and unlock unique gameplay advantages, rewards, and new quests.

  • Choose Your Quests:
    Take on story-driven or skill-based quests that range from chill and casual to ambitious and challenging. Explore different professions, meet quirky NPCs, and shape your own narrative.

  • Craft, Earn, and Upgrade:
    Collect resources, craft items, and build your inventory. Trade with others, complete jobs, and grow your empire.

  • Social Sandbox:
    Socialize, party, or collaborate with friends. Customize your avatar and apartment. Express yourself through fashion, emotes, and voice chat.

  • Play to Progress:
    Enjoy a mix of mini-games, time-limited challenges, and daily tasks that reward you with XP, currency, and progress across your skills and traits.

👥 A Living, Breathing Metaverse

Yooca: Next Horizon is always evolving with seasonal events, limited-edition collectibles, and ever-expanding experiences. It’s not just where you play—it’s where you become who you want to be.

Your next life starts here.
What will you do in the Yooca?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 1060 or higher / AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 5600G or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 3050 or higher / AMD Radeon 6500XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
